info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v4-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscribe API allows users to opt out of weather alerts, streamlining their notification preferences. By invoking this endpoint, consumers can effectively manage their alert subscriptions based on personal preferences or changing needs. This operation is vital for users seeking to minimize unnecessary notifications while ensuring they remain informed only about relevant weather conditions. Ideal for mobile app developers and service providers aiming to enhance user experience, this API facilitates better control over communication with users.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from alerts, thereby stopping any further notifications from being sent to them. It is a necessary action for users who wish to manage their alert preferences and reduce unwanted communications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to unsubscribe from alerts. It must be sent as a JSON object containing the necessary parameters to identify the alert to be unsubscribed from.

200.description: Unsubscription successful; alerts will no longer be received.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for unsubscribing from alerts.

status.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with this unsubscribe request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the unsubscribe operation.

state.description: The state of the unsubscribe operation, which may provide additional context.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the unsubscribe request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the result of the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for the unsubscribe operation indicating the result of the operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created this unsubscribe record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the unsubscribe record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe operation was performed automatically.

Audit.description: Audit information regarding the unsubscribe operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time in milliseconds taken to process the request.
